headline: Their top complaint is customer support, not the app.
comparison_note: This is the first three-month period tracked, so there is no like-for-like comparison yet. For reference, the earlier monthly reports show September at 3.92 and October at 3.98.
release_note: No release stands out. None of the main versions is 5 points or more above the period's 1-star share. Reviews with no app version are the outlier, at [[versions.one_star_share@version=Not given|pct]] 1-star, and are worth a look with the app team.
asks_heading: Three asks for the next period

actions.title: Let users reach a person
actions.text: Support comes up in [[complaints.share@code=support|pct]] of written complaints, ahead of late delivery at [[complaints.share@code=late|pct]]. Users describe chatbots that never hand over to an agent. Review the escalation path and audit a sample of closed tickets for real resolution.
actions.measure: support share of complaints next period

actions.title: Look at the late-night experience
actions.text: From 8 pm to midnight, the busiest part of the day per hour, the average is [[windows.avg_rating@window=night|dec2]] against [[windows.avg_rating@window=afternoon|dec2]] from noon to 8 pm. Check rider supply and delivery-time promises in that window.

actions.title: Reply to every 1-star review properly
actions.text: [[kpis.one_star_unreplied#0|int]] one-star reviews got no reply, and [[kpis.one_star_top_template_share#0|pct]] of replies to 1-star reviews open with the same line. Cover every 1-star review with a reply that names the issue.
actions.measure: 1-star reply rate and share of templated 1-star replies
